mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teamup (id, type, title, leader, start_time, create_at, update_at,leader_name) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{title}, #{leader},#{startTime}, #{createAt}, #{updateAt},#{leaderName})

INSERT INTO comment_teamup(teamup_id, parent_id, text, picture, son, create_time, user_id, reply_user_id) VALUES (#{teamupId}, #{parentId}, #{text}, #{picture}, #{son}, #{createTime}, #{userId}, #{replyUserId})

INSERT INTO comment_circle(circle_id, parent_id, text, picture, son, create_time, user_id, reply_user_id) VALUES (#{circleId}, #{parentId}, #{text}, #{picture}, #{son}, #{createTime}, #{userId}, #{replyUserId})
